title: Wigo4it is a second federated buyer, serving the document-heavy social services of the four largest Dutch cities
content:
Wigo4it is the ICT cooperative for the social services of the four largest Dutch cities. Like Dimpact it is a federated buyer: one relationship covers the systems of all four members, and the decision is taken jointly rather than city by city.

What differentiates it from the other cooperative is the domain. The research notes that social services work is document-heavy, which gives it direct relevance to intelligent document processing — the evidence a case rests on arrives as documents, and the decisions taken on those documents are the substance of the service.

The two properties reinforce each other. A document-heavy domain generates the kind of decisions a record layer exists for, taken about individuals and open to challenge afterwards, while the federated structure means one integration serves four large municipalities. Its recorded tooling — Common Ground, and participation in the GZAC proof of concept — places it in the same technical family as the other Dutch leads here, so the integration surface is shared rather than bespoke.
